copy.title: Built for the way your industry works.
One team, five ways to work together.
What clients ask before we start.
copy.askText: Tell us about your project and we'll point you to the right fit.

items.a: We're an AI engineering and software development company with five service groups: {groups}. We also provide dedicated development teams, IT staff augmentation, and offshore development centers if you'd rather extend your own team. See Services for the full breakdown of each.

items.q: Which engagement model fits our project?
items.a: It depends on where you're starting from: an MVP Sprint for a fast first build, End-to-End Delivery when we own the whole scope, a Dedicated Development Team or IT Staff Augmentation to extend yours, or an Offshore Development Center for a long-term team we set up and run for you. Tell us where you are and we'll recommend a fit.

items.q: How do you use AI in the development process?
items.a: AI is assisted, not autonomous — it speeds up discovery, engineering, QA, and release, but a person still reviews the decisions that matter at every phase.

items.q: Can you redesign or maintain an existing product?
items.a: Yes — Legacy Software Modernization, eCommerce Migration, and Website Maintenance & Support cover platform migrations, UI refreshes, and ongoing upkeep without a ground-up rebuild.

items.q: What industries do you have experience in?
items.a: SaaS, eCommerce & retail, and eight more — see Industries for the full list and how each workflow is adapted to what makes that business different.

items.q: Where is your team based, and how do you handle time zones?
items.a: Bangladesh is our delivery hub. Japan, the USA, the UK, Australia, and New Zealand give us collaboration hubs across time zones, so there's working overlap wherever you're based.

items.q: Do you work with early-stage startups or only larger companies?
items.a: Both. MVP Sprint and Dedicated Development Team engagements suit early-stage teams moving fast; End-to-End Delivery and an Offshore Development Center suit larger, more established organizations with more scope to cover.
Book a call or send us a brief — we'll walk through scope, timeline, and the engagement model that fits before anything is signed.
